post.description:
If a `reimbursement_id` is provided, the receipt will be linked directly to that reimbursement. If not, Ramp will attempt to automatically create a draft reimbursement via OCR.

This endpoint accepts the [multipart/form-data](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Methods/POST) format.

Include the receipt image as a part with `Content-Disposition: attachment`. Include metadata as parts with `Content-Disposition: form-data`.

patch.description:
Send line_items with amounts (in minor units) to create or replace the
transaction's split; the line item amounts must sum to the transaction
amount. Each line item can carry its own memo and accounting field
selections. Send an empty line_items array to unsplit (remove all line
items). Returns the updated transaction.
patch.summary: Split a transaction into line items, or update an existing split

user_id.description: Unique identifier of the card owner.

allowed_overage_percent_override.description: Fund-level override for the allowed overage percent. This is a decimal value between 0 and 100, where `10` means 10%. If null, the limit inherits from the spend program or business default.

created_at.description: Time at which the limit is created, presented in ISO8601 format.

spend_program_id.description: Unique identifier of the associated Spend Program.

user_id.description: Unique identifier of the user this limit is assigned to.

accounting_categories.description: [Deprecated - use accounting_field_selections instead] Accounting categories related to the transaction.

accounting_date.description: The date for the transaction for accounting purposes, in ISO8601 format. Based on the cleared date, transaction date, or a manually overridden date, depending on your accounting preferences in Ramp.

accounting_field_selections.description: List of accounting fields selected to code the transaction.

all_requirements_met_and_approved.description: Whether the transaction is fully approved and all cardholder requirements are met, including receipts, memos, and tracking categories.

attendees.description: List of attendees for the transaction

card_id.description: Identifier of the physical or virtual card associated with the transaction.

card_present.description: Whether the transaction was processed using a card present terminal.

disputes.description: A list of disputes sorted in descending order by their creation time.

entity_amount.description: The amount that settled to the entity, in the entity's settlement currency. The value is in the smallest denomination of the currency (e.g. cents for USD) and is signed: refunds and credits can be negative. Null when the transaction has no valid settlement currency recorded.

entity_id.description: Unique identifier of business entity associated with the transaction.

fund_id.description: Unique identifier of the fund associated with the transaction. Returns the same value as `limit_id`.

limit_id.description: Alias of fund (`fund_id`). Unique identifier of the spend limit associated with the transaction. Returns the same value as `fund_id`.

line_items.description: List of line items related to the transaction.

merchant_amount.description: The original amount charged by the merchant, in the currency the merchant charged. The value is in the smallest denomination of that currency (e.g. cents) and is signed: refunds and credits can be negative. Equal to `entity_amount` when no currency conversion occurred. Null when the original amount data is unavailable or invalid.

merchant_category_code.description: Merchant category code is a four-digit number in ISP 18245 used to classify a business by the types of goods and services it provides.

merchant_category_code_description.description: Description about the merchant category code.

merchant_data.description: Purchase data associated related to a transaction provided by the merchant

merchant_descriptor.description: A merchant descriptor is the name that appears on a customer's bank statement when they make a purchase from that merchant.

merchant_location.description: Card acceptor data such as country, city, state, and postal code if available.

minor_unit_conversion_rate.description: The conversion factor to convert from the integer amount to the actual currency value. Divide amount by this value to get the real currency amount. For USD, this is 100 (e.g., 12034 / 100 = 120.34 USD).

network_merchant_id.description: Network merchant identifier from the card acceptor.

original_transaction_amount.description: the original transaction amount before the currency conversion.

original_transaction_id.description: Original transaction id for refund transactions.

policy_violations.description: A list of policy violations sorted in descending order by their creation time.

receipts.description: Receipts listed in ascending order by their creation time, related to the transaction.

requires_accounting_vendor_creation_to_s.description: Whether the integrator must create an accounting vendor and code it to this transaction before syncing. True when the connection has transaction_accounting_vendor_creation_on_sync_enabled=true and the transaction has no vendor accounting field selection. Omitted when transaction_accounting_vendor_creation_on_sync_enabled=false.

settlement_date.description: Time when funds were moved for a transaction, in ISO8601 format.

spend_program_id.description: Unique identifier of the spend program from which this limit was issued.

x-enum-descriptions.ALL: Special filter value to include all transaction states
x-enum-descriptions.CLEARED: Transaction has been cleared and settled
x-enum-descriptions.ERROR: Transaction encountered an error during processing
x-enum-descriptions.PENDING: Transaction is pending and has not yet cleared
x-enum-descriptions.PENDING_INITIATION: Transaction has not yet been initiated

statement_id.description: Statement ID associated with the transaction if one is available.

x-enum-descriptions.NOT_SYNC_READY: The object is missing required accounting setup and is not ready to sync.
x-enum-descriptions.SYNCED: The object has already been synced to the accounting provider.
x-enum-descriptions.SYNC_READY: The object is ready to sync to the accounting provider.

synced_at.description: Time when transaction has been synced, in ISO8601 format. Will be None if the transaction is not synced.

trip_id.description: Trip ID associated with the transaction if one is available.

trip_name.description: Trip name associated with the transaction if one is available.

updated_at.description: Approximate transaction updated timestamp used by the `updated_after` filter. Computed as the latest of user transaction time, settlement time, and transaction interaction state update time.

user_transaction_time.description: Time when the transaction was created by the user, in ISO8601 format.

accounting_field_selections.description: Accounting field selections used to code this line item.

memo.description: Memo text for this line item.

DeveloperAPICountedPage.description: Pagination details for a Developer API response, with an optional total count.

next.description: the query to get to the next page; it is in the format of <BASE_URL>?<new_params>

total_count.description: Total number of results matching the query, at most 10,000. Null when include_count is not set, or when the count could not be computed in time.

total_count_capped.description: Whether more than 10,000 results match, in which case total_count is 10,000. Null whenever total_count is null.

additional_info.description: Structured details specific to this error.

notes.description: Optional additional context about the error.

user_id.description: User ID of the attendee, if linked to a Ramp user. Missing if the attendee is not a Ramp user

category_info.description: Information about the parent accounting category.

display_name.description: Customer-set display name for the accounting field option in Ramp. When the customer renames an option inside Ramp, this returns the new label while `name` continues to return the ERP-source name. May be null if no Ramp-side override is set.

external_code.description: External code displayed in the ERP for this option.

external_id.description: External ID that uniquely identifies this option in the ERP.

id.description: Unique identifier for this option within Ramp.

name.description: Name of the accounting field option.

source.description: Source of this accounting coding selection.

x-enum-descriptions.SALES_TAX_CODE: A sales tax code from the accounting provider.

field_option_id.description: UUID of the accounting field selection

field_external_id.description: Remote ID of the accounting field in the ERP system. Provide exactly one of field_id or field_external_id.

field_id.description: UUID of the accounting field. Provide exactly one of field_id or field_external_id.

field_option_external_id.description: Remote ID of the accounting field option in the ERP system. Provide exactly one of field_option_id, field_option_external_id, or free_form_text.

field_option_id.description: UUID of the accounting field option. Provide exactly one of field_option_id, field_option_external_id, or free_form_text.

free_form_text.description: Free form text for the accounting field selection. For DATE-type fields, use ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD). Provide exactly one of field_option_id, field_option_external_id, or free_form_text.

department_id.description: ID of the card holder's department.

department_name.description: Name of the card holder's deparment.

employee_id.description: User-defined employee ID of the card holder.

location_id.description: ID of the card holder's location.

location_name.description: Name of the card holder's location.

accounting_field_selections.description: Accounting field selections for this line item. Each field and option may be identified by Ramp ID or by ERP remote ID.

memo.description: Memo for this line item (e.g. a case ID).

created_at.description: Time at which the dispute is created, presented in ISO8601 format.

memo.description: Free form text regarding the dispute.

type.description: The dispute type; It could be one of the following values: RESOLVED_BY_RAMP, CANCELLED_BY_CUSTOMER, CANCELLED_BY_RAMP, CREATED_MERCHANT_ERROR and CREATED_UNRECOGNIZED_CHARGE.

amount.description: Declined amount, denominated in the transaction's settlement currency (the transaction's `currency_code`).

declined_amount.description: Declined amount with its currency. The currency is the transaction's settlement currency (matches the transaction's `currency_code`). The value is signed: declined refunds/credits can be negative. Null when the transaction has no valid settlement currency recorded; the bare `amount` field always carries the raw value.

x-enum-descriptions.AUTHORIZER_CARD_CATEGORY_BLACKLIST: Merchant category blocked for this card
x-enum-descriptions.AUTHORIZER_CARD_CATEGORY_WHITELIST: Merchant category not allowed for this card
x-enum-descriptions.AUTHORIZER_CARD_MCC_BLACKLIST: Merchant category blocked for this card
x-enum-descriptions.AUTHORIZER_CARD_MISSING_POLICY_ITEMS: Card locked due to missing required items
x-enum-descriptions.AUTHORIZER_CARD_START_DATE: Card spend eligibility has not started
x-enum-descriptions.AUTHORIZER_CARD_TASK_SANCTION: Card locked due to overdue tasks
x-enum-descriptions.AUTHORIZER_CARD_VENDOR_WHITELIST: Merchant not allowed for this card
x-enum-descriptions.AUTHORIZER_SPEND_ALLOCATION_MEMBER_SUSPE: Member access to spending limit is locked
x-enum-descriptions.AUTHORIZER_TRANSACTION_AMOUNT_LIMIT: Transaction amount exceeded the per-transaction limit
x-enum-descriptions.AUTHORIZER_UNAUTHORIZED_USER: User account is no longer active
x-enum-descriptions.AUTHORIZER_UNDER_TRANSACTION_AMOUNT_LIMI: Transaction amount fell below the per-transaction minimum
x-enum-descriptions.CARD_LOST_OR_STOLEN: Card reported as lost or stolen
x-enum-descriptions.MOBILE_WALLET_TOKEN_TERMINATED: Mobile wallet token has been terminated
x-enum-descriptions.NO_LINKED_SPEND_ALLOCATION: No spending limit linked to this card

created_at.description: Date time at which the card is created. It conforms to ISO8601 format

fund_id.description: Unique identifier of the associated fund.

is_card_suspended.description: Whether the virtual card has been locked.

user_id.description: Unique identifier of the card owner.

accounting_field_selections.description: List of accounting field options selected to code the line item.

amount.description: Amount of the line item, denominated in the currency that the transaction was settled in.

converted_amount.description: Amount of the split line item, converted to the currency of the card on which the transaction occurred.

id.description: Stable Ramp identifier for a persisted split line. Null for generated lines.

memo.description: Memo associated with the line item.

type.description: Describes the type of source that added this selection.
